figures.name: line02_source_partition
figures.observed: Five native diagonal contributions, highlighted direct Ly-alpha term and matched signed-departure magnitudes are readable. Log scales and rate units are visible; no cropped labels.
figures.scope_note: The positive plotted magnitudes apply to the saved state; they do not establish universally positive microscopic gross rates.

figures.name: line02_affine_response
figures.observed: Three identified r/r0 tracks over b/b0=.8 to 1.2; population response and signed event-rate panels are readable, with zero crossing visible and no clipping.
figures.scope_note: 183 fixed-block algebraic plot samples, not trajectories; the source at b/b0=1 is small but is not asserted exactly zero.

figures.name: line02_angular_ledger
figures.observed: Six synthetic-opacity C/D controls and three actual scalar-state energy/normalized tensor injections are visually separated. Direct bound-bound scope is explicit; axes and units readable.
figures.scope_note: Lower-right bars are diagonal tensor components normalized by scalar energy injection, not evolved stress; photon number is recorded in ANGULAR_LEDGER.csv and related to energy by the declared E21.
figures.minor_layout_note: The lower-left energy legend partly covers the upper portion of the rotated radiation bar. Its height and energy equality remain available from other bars and raw data; no scientific acceptance blocker.
